title: Final answer for N
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the correct number of pump strokes, N = 8.

title: Applies Boyle's Law
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Boyle's Law (pV = constant) to the isothermal compression of air into the ball.

title: Models total air volume
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning must account for the total volume of air (ball volume + N * stroke volume) at the initial pressure before compression into the ball.

title: Correct pressure identification
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify the initial pressure of the pumped air and the final target pressure inside the basketball.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The working demonstrates consistent use of units (Liters and Pascals) or correctly notes that volumes can be used in ratio.

title: Neglects volume addition
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the solution incorrectly assumes the ball's volume remains exactly 8L during pumping, ignoring the added volume of N strokes.

title: Misapplies pressure relation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the solution uses a simple ratio of pressures (e.g., 1.5/1.0) without considering the volume of air added.
